## Intended Lean form of the main statements

```lean
-- T08, a.e. part
theorem commuting_ergodic_averages_converge_ae
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {T S : X → X} (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ μ) (hS : MeasurePreserving S μ μ)
    (hTS : Function.Commute T S) {p q : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hpq : p⁻¹ + q⁻¹ ≤ 1) {f g : X → ℂ} (hf : MemLp f p μ) (hg : MemLp g q μ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ l : ℂ, Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ergodicAvg T S f g N x) atTop (𝓝 l)
-- T08, norm part: if 0 < p⁻¹ + q⁻¹ and r = (p⁻¹ + q⁻¹)⁻¹, there is F ∈ L^r
-- with eLpNorm (A_N - F) r μ → 0 (F also the a.e. limit);
-- for p = q = ∞ the same for every finite r ≥ 1.
```

`ergodicAvg T S f g N x = (N : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, f (T^[n] x) * g (S^[n] x)`.
